name: Budget
descriptor: One row per envelope: what you planned, what you spent, what is left, and a bar that says it in one glance.
verify_checks: variance: the remaining maths is emitted
pros: remaining is derived, so it cannot drift from planned and actual
the bar answers the question before the number does
an overspend is flagged in the warning colour, not buried in a total
it is the same rows as any list, so search and export still work
cons: two numbers per row: no transactions, no running ledger
no period: a budget is whatever the rows say it is
the bar is proportional to the row, not to the whole budget
best_for: a handful of envelopes you check once a month
avoid_if: you need a ledger of individual transactions
